name: smwpatches-four-digits-timer-v2
title: Four Digits Timer v2.0
description:
This patch allows timers > 999 to be displayed properly.

To set 4-digit timers in Lunar Magic's timer bypass, use A-F for the hundreds digit (for example, C34 becomes 1234). The maximum is 1599 (F99).

This version:
- fixes the 4th digit's color (optional-- can be disabled if you've rearranged the status bar)
- properly displays 4-digit timers and 6-digit products in the course clear message
- calculates the product correctly, without overflowing when the timer > 399 or the product > 65535
- increases the countdown rate so that the entire bonus is added before the goal scene ends
- allows for up to three initial timers > 1599 by replacing the default 200/300/400
- allows the bonus multiplier to be customized from 10 to 90
